claim: Apple does not disclose Apple Pay revenue as a separate line item; an Apple spokesperson confirmed this directly to Payments Dive in August 2024.
stance_target: Apple's disclosure practice for Apple Pay revenue
scope_conditions: As of FY2024 Q3 earnings (quarter ended June 29, 2024)
quoted_support: However, an Apple spokesperson said the company does not disclose revenue from individual services like Apple Pay.

claim: Apple's Services category (which includes payments) generated a record $24.21 billion in FY2024 Q3 revenue, up 14% year-over-year, with Tim Cook stating payments revenue specifically reached an all-time quarterly high.
stance_target: growth trajectory of Apple's Services/payments revenue
quoted_support: The Cupertino, California-based company said its overall services category -- which includes payments -- also logged a record, generating $24.21 billion in revenue for the quarter... Revenue from its payment services reached an all-time quarterly high for its fiscal third quarter ended June 29, Apple CEO Tim Cook said.
